summary: Paranovus Entertainment Technology Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into an at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with AC Sunshine Securities LLC. The ATM program, registered on a shelf Form F-3, authorizes the sale of up to $194,999,999.75 in Class A ordinary shares through ordinary brokerage transactions on Nasdaq. The agent receives a 3.5% commission on gross proceeds. There is no premium, fixed price, or board recommendation; this is a routine equity distribution facility, not a special situation event.
